summary:
ArtemisQuest: Beyond Earth – Lunar & Martian Survival Simulator

ArtemisQuest: Beyond Earth is an interactive Lunar and Martian outpost survival simulator that places players in the role of mission commander. Players choose a Shackleton Rim lunar expedition or a Martian surface mission, explore the outpost, operate specialized facilities and complete engineering mini-games. They balance resources including power, oxygen, water and food, while monitoring crew health and responding to equipment failures and emergency events. Solar arrays, water recovery, oxygen production, carbon-dioxide processing, research and habitat systems introduce mission decisions. By combining exploration, resource strategy and consequence-based gameplay, ArtemisQuest makes the challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth engaging and accessible.
details:
ArtemisQuest is an interactive space-outpost survival simulator that explores the challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon and Mars.

Players take on the role of an astronaut mission commander, managing a five-Sol survival mission. They explore planetary outposts, operate specialized facilities, complete engineering mini-games and manage essential resources, including oxygen, water, electricity and food.

The Lunar and Martian environments feature unique challenges such as water and oxygen production, power management, radiation protection, dust storms and equipment failures. Players must maintain life-support systems, monitor crew health and respond to emergencies.

Developed using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and Vite, ArtemisQuest combines interactive gameplay with space science concepts.

The project aims to promote STEM education, critical thinking and problem-solving by allowing students to experience the engineering and survival challenges of human exploration beyond Earth.
